During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a '''power station''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. The station was destroyed by a joint [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;[[Sessehshellah]] [[Sabotage of an Imperial power station|assault]].
